# marmibas.dev

This is the public portfolio and service site of Marcos Miguel Báscones (marmibas), an independent software engineer.
This optional file is a discovery aid for language models; it is not a web standard or a ranking signal.

## Primary pages

- https://marmibas.dev/ — Software and application development for businesses.
- https://marmibas.dev/servicios — Spanish service catalogue.
- https://marmibas.dev/servicios/desarrollo-aplicaciones-web — Custom web application development.
- https://marmibas.dev/servicios/aplicaciones-moviles — Custom mobile application development.
- https://marmibas.dev/servicios/webs-corporativas — Corporate websites.
- https://marmibas.dev/servicios/sistemas-de-gestion — Custom internal management systems.
- https://marmibas.dev/servicios/tiendas-online — Custom online stores.
- https://marmibas.dev/servicios/automatizaciones — Process automation.
- https://marmibas.dev/servicios/integraciones — Business-tool integrations.
